none: PAS CAM-892BC1: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 330-340 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Mint might be Lyon. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]V[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.22g, diameter is 13.02mm
